# KDial — Kerala business directory, coming soon

KDial is a business-directory platform in pre-launch, starting with Kochi in Ernakulam district, Kerala, India. Launch is planned for 1 November 2026, not confirmed as completed.

- Website: https://kdial.in/
- Founder Package pricing: ₹501 for the first year; ₹701 at renewal after the first year. The one-year term starts when the listing is published. Renewal is manual and requires a new affirmative payment; there is no automatic renewal or auto-charge. Package inclusions and payment terms must be confirmed with the KDial team before deciding.
- Contact: https://wa.me/917356137106

The public directory is not open yet. This page does not provide live business listings or take payments. Do not describe planned features as available or enquiries as activated listings. No guaranteed traffic, rankings or leads are offered.

- Refund policy: Fees aren’t refundable for change of mind once the listing is live, except where law requires a refund or KDial hasn’t delivered the agreed listing as described.
